study_type_evidence.quote: Biotinylated scFv or scFv-CD (250 μg) was administrated by IP injection into 4-month-old female B6C3F1 mice.
Organotypic slice cultures (brain slice cultures) were transduced with scFv9 and scFv9-CD.
To overexpress scFvs, 2.7 μg plasmid were transiently transfected into HEK293T cells in a 6-well dish using polyethylenimine.

in_vivo_species.quote: Biotinylated scFv or scFv-CD (250 μg) was administrated by IP injection into 4-month-old female B6C3F1 mice.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: TgCRND8 mice (transgenic for human APP K670N, M671L, V717F, APPswe/ind) and non-transgenic littermates, injected at P0, both sexes, aged 3 or 6 months
in_vivo_species.quote: we delivered rAAV2/1-CD into the cerebral ventricles of newborn TgCRND8 mice (transgenic for human APP K670N, M671L, V717F, and APPswe/ind)

in_vivo_species.quote: female BALB/c mice (n = 5) were immunized with synthetic peptides corresponding to the β-secretase cleavage site in APP (APP666–677) conjugated to KLH

ex_vivo_detail: Mouse organotypic brain slice cultures were transduced with scFv9 and scFv9-CD, and the secreted proteins in conditioned media were assayed for Abeta1-42 binding (Figures S3A and S3B). Brain RIPA extracts from injected mice were also assayed for Abeta1-42 aggregate binding.
in_vitro_detail: HEK293T transient transfection and conditioned-media analysis (SDS-PAGE, immunoblot, size exclusion chromatography); direct ELISA of secreted scFvs, scFv-CDs and decoy-receptor-CD fusions against coated alpha-synuclein (21-140), ptau, tau MTBR4, Abeta1-16, Abeta fibrils and Abeta1-42 aggregates; cell-free Abeta42 aggregation assay monitored by Thioflavin T fluorescence; hybridoma generation and screening.

bioanalytical_method: Direct ELISA with Abeta40 (5 μg/well) as capture and NeutrAvidin-HRP as detection, against a purified scFv standard
bioanalytical_quote: Levels of biotinylated scFv were determined by direct ELISA with Aβ40 (5 μg/well) as capture and NeutrAvidin-HRP as detection. Purified scFv was used as standard.
notes: PK was measured only for biotinylated scFv9 and scFv9-CD after a single 250 μg IP dose; no PK was measured for scFvB11, scFvB11-CD, scFv12, scFv12-CD or CD alone. Half-life was 'calculated by nonlinear regression analysis of one-phase decay', i.e. a single-phase fit, and the paper never names the phase, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and both half_life_absorption and half_life_elimination are left 'not reported' per protocol - the 0.74 h and 1.82 h values must not be read as fitted elimination-phase parameters. No error terms, Cmax, tmax or AUC are reported. Note that the route is intraperitoneal, so an absorption phase certainly exists physiologically but was not modelled or reported. Internal inconsistency in the body: Figure 1D/1E label scFv12 as 'against N-terminal a-syn', while Figures 4-7 and the accompanying Results describe scFv12 as an anti-Abeta scFv derived from mAb 2B12; both usages are recorded as-is. Figure 6B legend writes 'scFvB12' where the Results text uses 'scFv12'. The Figure 3H caption states 100 mM Abeta42 whereas the Methods state 100 μM. The rAAV titre in the Methods is printed as '(10e genomes per milliliter)', which appears garbled in the source text, so no titre is recorded. The PEPLIFE2 header lists full scFv9 and scFv9-CD sequences, but that is database metadata and the body prints no sequences, so sequence is 'not reported' except for the ISEVKMDAEFRH immunogen fragment which is printed in the Figure 4A caption. Role 'other' is used for the immunogen and for synthetic Abeta42 because the protocol role enum does not cover immunogens or assay substrates.
